---
title: CLI Help
description: Current command-line help for Yamark.
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
  comment: ""
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-cli-help
#| include: false
source("_yamark-build.R")

yamark_help <- function(...) {
  args <- c(..., "--help")

  output <- system2(
    yamark_bin,
    args,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE,
    env = c("NO_COLOR=", "CLICOLOR_FORCE=1")
  )
  status <- attr(output, "status")

  if (!is.null(status)) {
    stop(
      "`", yamark_bin, " ", paste(args, collapse = " "), "` failed with status ", status,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  output <- sub("[ \t]+$", "", output, perl = TRUE)
  output <- htmltools::htmlEscape(output)
  output <- fansi::sgr_to_html(output, term.cap = "256")
  knitr::asis_output(paste0(
    "<pre class=\"yamark-cli-help\"><code>",
    paste(output, collapse = "\n"),
    "</code></pre>\n"
  ))
}
```

These are Yamark's current help screens. See [Usage](usage.qmd) for common
commands, [Directives](directives.qmd) for source-file controls, and
[Reference](reference.qmd) for accepted options and syntax.

## `yamark`

```{r}
#| label: help-yamark
#| results: asis
yamark_help()
```

## `yamark format`

```{r}
#| label: help-yamark-format
#| results: asis
yamark_help("format")
```

## `yamark git-filter`

```{r}
#| label: help-yamark-git-filter
#| results: asis
yamark_help("git-filter")
```
